page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for accelerated visual computing and machine learning tasks. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine supplies 56 vCPUs across 28 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory totals 346 GB, providing approximately 6.18 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and features a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No local storage is bundled with the instance, requiring network-attached cloud disks for persistent filesystem storage.

Benchmark results highlight strong performance in GPU-bound and parallel computational tasks. In language model inference, the instance achieves top-tier results for small and mid-sized models, recording 9738.91 prompt tokens per second on a 135M model and 2464.01 prompt tokens per second on a 7B parameter architecture. Multi-threaded processing shows high capability, with a PassMark CPU score of 51481.37, PassMark database operations reaching 22187.83, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieving 262.06 GB/sec. Memory subsystem bandwidth delivers 129.14 GB/sec for large uncached reads and 51.84 GB/sec for uncached writes, while standard web serving throughput reaches 35.1 GB/sec.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the instance offers balanced density by coupling dedicated x86 compute with an enterprise Ampere GPU, avoiding the operational overhead of multi-GPU topologies for workloads that fit within 24 GB of VRAM. A primary operational tradeoff is the complete absence of local NVMe storage, meaning disk I/O performance relies on remote storage configurations. Workloads that align with this profile include small-to-medium LLM inference, video transcoding, visual rendering, GPU-accelerated database operations, and high-concurrency scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine tailored for AI inference, graphics processing, and compute-heavy pipelines. Running on the x86_64 architecture with the KVM hypervisor, it features 56 dedicated vCPUs (28 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.9 GHz, paired with 346 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is delivered via an integrated NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. The platform includes 16 Gbps of baseline networking but omits bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block devices. Benchmarks demonstrate top-tier execution for 135M and 7B parameter model inference, complemented by strong multi-threaded decompression, database, and cryptographic test results. This configuration is particularly suited for real-time model serving, video encoding, visual workloads, and parallel batch processing.
